summary: Trinseo PLC filed an 8-K reporting that its standalone net assets are half or less of called-up share capital, triggering Section 1111 of the Irish Companies Act 2014. The company convened an extraordinary general meeting for September 23, 2026, with no resolutions proposed, as required for considering measures. This is a distress signal under Irish law, signaling potential balance-sheet impairment. No deal terms exist. Watch for future restructuring actions, capital raises, or asset sales as the company addresses solvency concerns.
